sections.title: Other Events.
sections.text:
On October 30, 2026, The Procter & Gamble Company (the “Company”) closed an underwritten public
offering of $750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.125% Notes due October 30, 2031, $750,000,000
aggregate principal amount of 5.300% Notes due October 30, 2033, $1,250,000,000 aggregate principal amount of
5.450% Notes due October 30, 2036 and $1,250,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.900% Notes due October
30, 2056 under the Company’s Registration Statement on Form S-3 (Registration No. 333-299472). Legal opinions
related to these notes are attached hereto as Exhibits (5)(a) and (5)(b) and are incorporated herein by reference.
